post:

Would you want to see more stories from the Galactic Civil War era, or should the franchise move on to new territory?

headline: You Can See Everything Tops Clayface
post:
There is a brand-new box office champion! Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s Elizabeth Holmes documentary, You Can See Everything, grabbed the No. 1 spot with $11.4 million. 

This knocked the DC body-horror movie Clayface down to No. 2 with $11 million in its second weekend. 

Which of these two theatrical releases did you like the best? 🎬

#BoxOffice #Clayface #Documentary
original_title: Clayface Just Lost the Box Office to 2026’s Biggest Surprise Hit & It’s A Game-Changing Moment For Movies

headline: Tomb of Apocalypse Debuts Ultimate Horsemen
post:
Hey comic fans! Nearly four decades after the team first hit Marvel lore, a brand new lineup has arrived. According to Screen Rant, "X-Men has assembled the ultimate version of the Horsemen" as guardians of the villain's hi-tech tomb. 

In the pages of Tomb of Apocalypse #3, characters like Wolverine, Jubilee, Rictor, and Shatterstar come face-to-face with these ancient servants plucked straight from across time and space. Because these time-tossed warriors cannot leave the interior of the tomb, the villain sets his sights on capturing Jubilee instead. 💀

Which classic X-Men villain would you want to see return next?

#XMen #Wolverine #MarvelComics
original_title: X-Men Debuts Ultimate Version Of Horsemen Of Apocalypse, All Members and Powers

headline: Clayface Breaks Body Horror Box Office Record
post:
Big box office news for the DCU! The horror film Clayface has officially become the highest-grossing pure body horror movie of all time, reaching an incredible $83 million worldwide and passing The Substance.

Following a strong second weekend bringing in an estimated $10.4 million, this scary DC Universe release continues to hold up impressively well at the box office. 🎬

Have you had a chance to check out Clayface in theaters yet?

#Clayface #DCU #BoxOffice
original_title: Clayface Just Broke a New Record & Beat The Award-Winning Body Horror Movie That’s a Perfect Companion Watch

headline: Marvel Names Doctor Doom's True Hero Nemesis
post:
Hey superhero fans! According to Screen Rant, Marvel has officially revealed that Doctor Doom's true heroic opposite in the cosmos is not actually Reed Richards. Instead, a preview for Challenges of Doom: Doctor Strange #1 shows that the Latverian tyrant's true opposite is Doctor Strange 🔮. 

While the rivalry between Doom and the leader of The Fantastic Four is legendary, stemming from their college roommate days and a fateful experiment, magic brings a brand new dynamic. The preview features a vision from the Ancient One highlighting Stephen Strange's future foes. 

Past stories like the 1989 graphic novel Triumph and Torment already showcased their complex history, where Strange helped Doom attempt to free his mother from Mephisto's realm. With Doom fighting his way back through time in the new miniseries following recent events, this magical rivalry is heating up even more.

Are you picking up this new issue?

#DoctorStrange #DoctorDoom #MarvelComics
original_title: Marvel Officially Names Doctor Doom's Hero Nemesis, And It Isn't Reed Richards
